title: I18n Compile Enforcement
description: Wrap i18next behind a typed port; enforce translation keys, locale parity, and toolbar category coverage at compile time; add nx typecheck gates.
summary: Extracted typed chrome bundles to ui/react/i18n-types.ts with UiTranslationSchema, UiTranslationKey, and ui.toolbar.parent.* for all toolbar categories. Wrapped i18next in UiI18nPort (uiI18n, useUiTranslation, setUiLocale); removed raw i18next reinit from coda. Sketchpad toolbar parent entries are typed and applied at register time; en/de parity fixed. Added nx typecheck targets and i18n-typecheck.ts gates for ui, framework platform/playground, cad, coda, and sketchpad. Framework UIToolbar uses typed keys; vitest covers toolbar parent resolution.
